name: resaleanything
description: Classifieds marketplace: Next.js frontend + Express/MongoDB backend

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm start --prefix backend" "npm start --prefix frontend"
